name: @office/domain-documents
description: Office documents & evidence domain module (OFF-008): the canonical project-scoped Document aggregate with immutable create-only revisions (explicit supersession chains), immutable EvidenceReference values that bind entities to a specific revision, a provider-neutral content-addressed ObjectStorage port, and audit events through the minimal typed EventSink port. Pure domain: no SQL, no migrations, no repository layer — deterministic, in-memory-testable, injected clock/id/hash suppliers. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/persistence (the SqlExecutor type of the EventSink port).
